zh: 邁爾斯-布里格斯性格測試，一種將人格分類為16種類型的心理測驗
en: Myers-Briggs personality test is a personality assessment tool that categorizes people into 16 personality types based on four dimensions.
en_example: The Myers-Briggs personality test is widely used to understand individual differences.
zh_example: 邁爾斯-布里格斯性格測試被廣泛用來理解個體差異。
ja: マイヤーズ・ブリッグス性格検査は、4つの次元に基づいて人を16の性格タイプに分類する性格評価ツールです。
local: Myers-Briggs personality test is a personality assessment tool that categorizes people into 16 personality types based on four dimensions.
ja_example: マイヤーズ・ブリッグス性格検査は、個人の違いを理解するために広く使われています。
local_example: The Myers-Briggs personality test is widely used to understand individual differences.

zh: 內向與外向，指人們獲取能量的方式，內向者從獨處獲得能量，外向者從外部環境獲得能量
en: Introversion versus extroversion is a dimension describing how people gain energy: introverts from being alone, extroverts from social interaction.
en_example: Introversion versus extroversion is the first dimension in the Myers-Briggs test.
zh_example: 內向與外向是邁爾斯-布里格斯測試中的第一個維度。
ja: 内向性と外向性は、人がどのようにエネルギーを得るかを表す次元で、内向的な人は一人でいることで、外向的な人は社交的な交流からエネルギーを得ます。
local: Introversion versus extroversion is a dimension describing how people gain energy: introverts from being alone, extroverts from social interaction.
ja_example: 内向性と外向性は、マイヤーズ・ブリッグス検査の最初の次元です。
local_example: Introversion versus extroversion is the first dimension in the Myers-Briggs test.

zh: 直覺與感覺，指人們看待世界的方式，直覺者注重想像和抽象概念，感覺者注重邏輯和事實
en: Intuition versus sensing is a dimension describing how people perceive the world: intuitives focus on ideas and concepts, sensors focus on facts and practicality.
en_example: Intuition versus sensing helps determine how a person views the world around them.
zh_example: 直覺與感覺幫助判斷一個人如何看待周遭的世界。
ja: 直感と感覚は、人が世界をどのように認識するかを示す次元で、直感型はアイデアや概念に注目し、感覚型は事実や実用性に注目します。
local: Intuition versus sensing is a dimension describing how people perceive the world: intuitives focus on ideas and concepts, sensors focus on facts and practicality.
ja_example: 直感と感覚は、人が周囲の世界をどのように見ているかを判断するのに役立ちます。
local_example: Intuition versus sensing helps determine how a person views the world around them.

zh: 思考與情感，指人們做決策的方式，思考者以理性判斷，情感者以感情為依據
en: Thinking versus feeling is a dimension describing how people make decisions: thinkers rely on logic, feelers rely on emotions.
en_example: Thinking versus feeling influences decision-making styles in the Myers-Briggs test.
zh_example: 思考與情感影響邁爾斯-布里格斯測試中的決策風格。
ja: 思考と感情は、人がどのように意思決定をするかを示す次元で、思考型は論理に基づき、感情型は感情に基づきます。
local: Thinking versus feeling is a dimension describing how people make decisions: thinkers rely on logic, feelers rely on emotions.
ja_example: 思考と感情は、マイヤーズ・ブリッグス検査における意思決定のスタイルに影響を与えます。
local_example: Thinking versus feeling influences decision-making styles in the Myers-Briggs test.

zh: 判斷與知覺，指他人如何看待你，判斷者被視為有組織且理性，知覺者則較隨性且靈活
en: Judging versus perceiving is a dimension describing how others perceive you: judging types appear organized and logical, perceiving types appear spontaneous and flexible.
en_example: Judging versus perceiving affects how people are seen by others in social contexts.
zh_example: 判斷與知覺影響人們在社交場合中被他人看待的方式。
ja: 判断と知覚は、他人があなたをどのように認識するかを示す次元で、判断型は組織的で論理的に見え、知覚型は自発的で柔軟に見えます。
local: Judging versus perceiving is a dimension describing how others perceive you: judging types appear organized and logical, perceiving types appear spontaneous and flexible.
ja_example: 判断と知覚は、社会的な場面で人が他者からどう見られるかに影響します。
local_example: Judging versus perceiving affects how people are seen by others in social contexts.

zh: 指揮官型人格，擅長制定並執行願景，具有領導魅力和權威
en: ENTJ is a personality type known as the Commander, excelling at creating and executing visions with natural leadership.
en_example: ENTJs are often great leaders because of their charisma and authority.
zh_example: ENTJ通常因其魅力和權威成為優秀的領導者。
ja: ENTJは指揮官と呼ばれる性格タイプで、ビジョンを作り実行することに優れ、自然なリーダーシップを持っています。
local: ENTJ is a personality type known as the Commander, excelling at creating and executing visions with natural leadership.
ja_example: ENTJはそのカリスマ性と権威のおかげで、しばしば優れたリーダーになります。
local_example: ENTJs are often great leaders because of their charisma and authority.

zh: 檢查者型人格，以有條理、細心和可靠著稱，尊重傳統與秩序
en: ISTJ is a personality type called the Inspector, known for being methodical, thorough, and dependable.
en_example: ISTJs achieve their goals through calm and steady progress.
zh_example: ISTJ透過冷靜且穩定的進展達成目標。
ja: ISTJは検査官と呼ばれる性格タイプで、几帳面で徹底的、信頼できることで知られています。
local: ISTJ is a personality type called the Inspector, known for being methodical, thorough, and dependable.
ja_example: ISTJは冷静で着実な進歩を通じて目標を達成します。
local_example: ISTJs achieve their goals through calm and steady progress.

zh: 辯論者型人格，喜歡辯論且不怕表達不同意見，具有反叛精神
en: ENTP is a personality type known as the Debater, who enjoys engaging in debates and challenging the status quo.
en_example: ENTPs love nothing more than a great debate, even if their opinion is the odd one out.
zh_example: ENTP喜歡激烈辯論，即使意見與眾不同也不畏懼。
ja: ENTPは討論者と呼ばれる性格タイプで、議論に参加し現状に挑戦することを楽しみます。
local: ENTP is a personality type known as the Debater, who enjoys engaging in debates and challenging the status quo.
ja_example: ENTPは自分の意見が少数派でも、熱心に議論を楽しみます。
local_example: ENTPs love nothing more than a great debate, even if their opinion is the odd one out.

zh: 工匠型人格，重視透過實作學習，喜歡冒險和刺激的活動
en: ISTP is a personality type called the Crafter, who values hands-on experience and often pursues careers in engineering or science.
en_example: ISTPs enjoy learning through hands-on experience and thrill-seeking activities.
zh_example: ISTP喜歡透過實作學習及尋求刺激的活動。
ja: ISTPは「職人」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、実践的な経験を重視し、エンジニアリングや科学の分野でのキャリアを追求することが多いです。
local: ISTP is a personality type called the Crafter, who values hands-on experience and often pursues careers in engineering or science.
ja_example: ISTPは実際に手を動かして学ぶことやスリルを求める活動を楽しみます。
local_example: ISTPs enjoy learning through hands-on experience and thrill-seeking activities.

zh: 說服者型人格，外向、理性且善於快速決策，適合銷售等快節奏工作
en: ESTP is a personality type known as the Persuader, outgoing and logical, skilled at quick decision-making and thriving in fast-paced environments.
en_example: ESTPs are efficient problem solvers who enjoy putting out fires.
zh_example: ESTP是有效率的問題解決者，喜歡處理緊急狀況。
ja: ESTPは「説得者」として知られる性格タイプで、社交的かつ論理的で、迅速な意思決定が得意で、スピード感のある環境で活躍します。
local: ESTP is a personality type known as the Persuader, outgoing and logical, skilled at quick decision-making and thriving in fast-paced environments.
ja_example: ESTPは効率的に問題を解決し、緊急事態に対応することを好みます。
local_example: ESTPs are efficient problem solvers who enjoy putting out fires.

zh: 守護者型人格，樂於為所愛的人付出，常被視為無私
en: ISFJ is a personality type called the Protector, known for standing up for loved ones and selflessly caring for others.
en_example: ISFJs often sacrifice their own needs to help those they love.
zh_example: ISFJ常為所愛的人犧牲自己的需求。
ja: ISFJは「守護者」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、愛する人を守り、他者のために自己犠牲を厭わないことで知られています。
local: ISFJ is a personality type called the Protector, known for standing up for loved ones and selflessly caring for others.
ja_example: ISFJは自分のニーズを犠牲にしてでも、大切な人を助けることがよくあります。
local_example: ISFJs often sacrifice their own needs to help those they love.

zh: 建築師型人格，邏輯且策略性強，對自己和他人有高標準
en: INTJ is a personality type called the Architect, highly logical and strategic with high expectations for self and others.
en_example: INTJs often find success due to their pursuit of excellence.
zh_example: INTJ因追求卓越而常常獲得成功。
ja: INTJは「建築家」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、高度に論理的かつ戦略的であり、自分や他人に対して高い期待を持っています。
local: INTJ is a personality type called the Architect, highly logical and strategic with high expectations for self and others.
ja_example: INTJは卓越を追求することで成功を収めることが多いです。
local_example: INTJs often find success due to their pursuit of excellence.

zh: 主管型人格，擅長快速有效地完成任務和管理他人
en: ESTJ is a personality type called the Director, known for efficient task completion and strong management skills.
en_example: ESTJs make great leaders due to their ability to get things done quickly.
zh_example: ESTJ因能快速完成任務而成為優秀領導者。
ja: ESTJは「指揮官」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、効率的に仕事をこなし、優れた管理能力を持っています。
local: ESTJ is a personality type called the Director, known for efficient task completion and strong management skills.
ja_example: ESTJは物事を迅速に進める能力があるため、優れたリーダーになります。
local_example: ESTJs make great leaders due to their ability to get things done quickly.

zh: 調解者型人格，富有想像力，喜歡在內心世界中創造故事
en: INFP is a personality type called the Mediator, imaginative and often lost in inventive inner worlds and stories.
en_example: INFPs spend much time daydreaming and creating inner worlds.
zh_example: INFP喜歡花很多時間做白日夢和創造內心世界。
ja: INFPは「仲介者」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、想像力豊かで、しばしば独創的な内面世界や物語に没頭します。
local: INFP is a personality type called the Mediator, imaginative and often lost in inventive inner worlds and stories.
ja_example: INFPは多くの時間を空想にふけり、内なる世界を創造しています。
local_example: INFPs spend much time daydreaming and creating inner worlds.

zh: 藝術家型人格，富有創造力且注重當下體驗
en: ISFP is a personality type called the Artist, creative and focused on extracting value from the present moment.
en_example: ISFPs prefer enjoying experiences now rather than worrying about the future.
zh_example: ISFP喜歡享受當下的體驗，而非擔心未來。
ja: ISFPは「芸術家」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、創造的で現在の瞬間から価値を見出すことに集中します。
local: ISFP is a personality type called the Artist, creative and focused on extracting value from the present moment.
ja_example: ISFPは未来を心配するよりも、今の体験を楽しむことを好みます。
local_example: ISFPs prefer enjoying experiences now rather than worrying about the future.

zh: 冠軍型人格，善於激勵他人實現目標，常為激勵講師或教師
en: ENFP is a personality type called the Champion, gifted at inspiring and motivating others naturally.
en_example: ENFPs find purpose in helping others succeed.
zh_example: ENFP在幫助他人成功中找到人生目標。
ja: ENFPは「擁護者」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、人を自然に励まし、動機づける才能があります。
local: ENFP is a personality type called the Champion, gifted at inspiring and motivating others naturally.
ja_example: ENFPは他人の成功を助けることにやりがいを感じます。
local_example: ENFPs find purpose in helping others succeed.

zh: 思想家型人格，喜歡獨處思考並用邏輯解決問題
en: INTP is a personality type called the Thinker, who prefers solitude and solving problems with logic.
en_example: INTPs excel in fields requiring logical problem solving like science and engineering.
zh_example: INTP擅長需要邏輯解決問題的科學和工程領域。
ja: INTPは「思考者」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、一人でいることを好み、論理的に問題を解決することを得意とします。
local: INTP is a personality type called the Thinker, who prefers solitude and solving problems with logic.
ja_example: INTPは科学や工学のような論理的な問題解決が求められる分野で優れています。
local_example: INTPs excel in fields requiring logical problem solving like science and engineering.

zh: 照顧者型人格，善於調和環境並解決衝突，敏感他人情緒
en: ESFJ is a personality type called the Caregiver, skilled at creating harmony and resolving conflicts by understanding others' feelings.
en_example: ESFJs are great at bringing people together and meeting their needs.
zh_example: ESFJ擅長團結人群並滿足他人需求。
ja: ESFJは「世話人」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、調和を作り出し、他人の気持ちを理解して対立を解決するのが得意です。
local: ESFJ is a personality type called the Caregiver, skilled at creating harmony and resolving conflicts by understanding others' feelings.
ja_example: ESFJは人々をまとめ、彼らのニーズに応えるのが上手です。
local_example: ESFJs are great at bringing people together and meeting their needs.

zh: 表演者型人格，喜歡成為焦點，善於講故事且關心他人感受
en: ESFP is a personality type called the Performer, thriving in the spotlight and sensitive to others' feelings.
en_example: ESFPs often pursue careers in entertainment like acting and music.
zh_example: ESFP常從事演藝相關職業，如演戲和音樂。
ja: ESFPは「パフォーマー」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、注目を浴びることを好み、他人の感情に敏感です。
local: ESFP is a personality type called the Performer, thriving in the spotlight and sensitive to others' feelings.
ja_example: ESFPは俳優や音楽などのエンターテインメントの仕事に就くことが多いです。
local_example: ESFPs often pursue careers in entertainment like acting and music.

zh: 倡導者型人格，罕見且具有矛盾特質，致力於改善人類社會
en: INFJ is a rare personality type called the Advocate, logical yet emotional, imaginative yet analytical, focused on bettering humanity.
en_example: INFJs are drawn to careers like social work or medicine to help others.
zh_example: INFJ傾向從事社會工作或醫療職業以幫助他人。
ja: INFJは「提唱者」と呼ばれる珍しい性格タイプで、論理的でありながら感情的、想像力豊かで分析的、人類のためにより良くしようと努めます。
local: INFJ is a rare personality type called the Advocate, logical yet emotional, imaginative yet analytical, focused on bettering humanity.
ja_example: INFJは社会福祉や医療のような人を助ける仕事に惹かれます。
local_example: INFJs are drawn to careers like social work or medicine to help others.

zh: 給予者型人格，外向且關心他人，具備激勵他人的領導力
en: ENFJ is a personality type called the Giver, extroverted and caring, naturally inspiring and leading others to improve the world.
en_example: ENFJs are attentive leaders passionate about making the world better.
zh_example: ENFJ是熱心改善世界的細心領導者。
ja: ENFJは「与える人」と呼ばれる性格タイプで、外向的で思いやりがあり、自然に人を励まし世界を良くするリーダーです。
local: ENFJ is a personality type called the Giver, extroverted and caring, naturally inspiring and leading others to improve the world.
ja_example: ENFJは世界をより良くすることに情熱を持った注意深いリーダーです。
local_example: ENFJs are attentive leaders passionate about making the world better.
